rules.enhancementNote: Rituals that grant abilities take one of the target's Enhancement Slots.

rituals.name: Planar Commune
rituals.summary: Ask one of the six Primary Planes or a Planar Realm for insight on a planned action.

rituals.name: Planar Asylum
rituals.summary: Gives the target Planar Asylum for one Plane.

rituals.name: Unlearn
rituals.summary: Target removes the top level of one chosen skill and gets back the XP spent on it.

rituals.name: Planar Gate
rituals.summary: Open a 10 ft Gate to a Primary Plane or Planar Realm for up to 10 minutes.

rituals.name: Race Change
rituals.summary: Target becomes another base race from the rulebook; racial skills are unlearned automatically.

rituals.name: Ritual Circle
rituals.summary: 10 ft circle that can be the target of later rituals this re-pop; up to 10 occupants all count as targets. One wall or circle at a time; needs a phys rep.

rituals.name: Healer's Grace
rituals.summary: Target holds a healing pool up to 10 x their Healing or Life Magic level, starting empty. Charge only in a safe place with numeric healing; release by touch, packet, or weapon in 5 point steps. Lasts to re-pop.

rituals.name: Summon Planar Creature
rituals.summary: Summon a standard creature of a plane for a task of at most one month that does not endanger it. It may join an adventure if the ritualist supplies a player; rough stats 100 soak, 10 damage, 2 absolute defenses, 3 basic offenses/skills/spells.

rituals.name: Transfer Augment
rituals.summary: Move one Augment between items if the target item has room; some Augments cannot move (ask a GM first).

rituals.name: Knowledge of Val'Therin
rituals.summary: Target regains two uses of each of their Basic skills.

rituals.name: Spirit Forge
rituals.summary: Target goes back to character creation with all XP unspent.

rituals.name: Elemental Imbuement

elementBonus.air: Each encounter: Levitate, plus one Evade or Blink use.
elementBonus.death: Each encounter starts with Enshroud Life and 25 Temporary Armor Points.
elementBonus.earth: Each encounter starts with one Strength use; also +1 passive weapon or claw damage that stacks with other passive damage.
elementBonus.fire: Elemental pool is doubled at the start of each encounter.
elementBonus.life: Each encounter starts with 25 Temporary Life Points; the Essence pool can become healing at 2:1.
elementBonus.water: Water Breathing and +1 passive relic damage (stacks with other passive relic damage).

rituals.summary: One imbuement at a time. Target becomes a relic of the element or swings it with any weapon for the re-pop, gets a 100 point elemental pool per encounter (10 point throws or swings), is Reduced against that element, and gains an element bonus (see elementBonus).

planarChart.name: Unlisted Realm
planarChart.note: Varies by realm; usually the matching plane's magic plus one more.
